items.title: Renaming keeps its place
items.text: Renaming a window or group in the sidebar (or with Change Window Title) no longer moves it in the all-windows list. Typing a new project: prefix still moves a window into that group.

items.title: Smooth collapse and expand
items.text: Collapsing or expanding the sidebar, by button or by dragging its edge, glides in step with the panes, with no jumps or jiggling.

items.title: + on the collapsed rail
items.text: The collapsed rail's + opens a new window, just like the panel header's.

items.title: Starts tidy
items.text: The all-windows list opens with every window folded.

items.title: Your titles stick
items.text: A window title you typed outranks any script's. ghoztty +rename leaves it alone, and +list --json reports title_set_by_user. The title survives restarts.

items.title: New windows fill the screen
items.text: New windows open maximized every time, never cascaded or moved to the last window's spot.

items.title: Even out with a double-click
items.text: Double-click a grip between two cards to even out the cards beside it.

items.title: Lighter strip shadows
items.text: Strip shadows are lighter and fade at their ends instead of being cut off.
